original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳西部区教师工会重申继续罢工，抗议未付津贴与晋升问题
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳西部区三大职前教师工会领导层重申将继续进行罢工，指示成员在另行通知前不要返岗。罢工原因涉及未支付的津贴和晋升方面的关切。该消息目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 加纳西部区三大职前教师工会领导层重申继续罢工
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The leadership of the three major pre-tertiary teacher unions in the Western Region has reaffirmed its commitment to the ongoing strike

key_facts.fact: 工会指示成员在另行通知前不要返岗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: directing members to remain away from work until further notice

key_facts.fact: 罢工涉及未支付津贴与晋升关切
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Western Region teacher unions reaffirm strike over unpaid allowances and promotion concerns

uncertainties: 该事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
